major_cooldowns.name: Avenging Wrath
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it before your other cooldowns so Execution Sentence, Wake of Ashes, and your on-use trinkets all land inside its window.

major_cooldowns.name: Execution Sentence
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it once Avenging Wrath is active, then keep hitting every target it caught with your other damage since that funnels into its payout.

major_cooldowns.name: Wake of Ashes
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it on cooldown as your main Holy Power generator, timing it inside Execution Sentence's window when both are up together.

major_cooldowns.name: Divine Toll
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it after your other cooldowns are already rolling; it does not need to be synced to Avenging Wrath.

defensives.name: Divine Shield
defensives.usage_rule: Use it to become immune to all damage when you would otherwise die, accepting that it blocks healing on you afterward.

defensives.name: Blessing of Protection
defensives.usage_rule: Cast it on yourself or an ally about to take fatal physical damage; it blocks the damage but also forbids healing them.

defensives.name: Blessing of Sacrifice
defensives.usage_rule: Cast it on a tank or ally under heavy damage to transfer a share of their damage taken to yourself.

defensives.name: Divine Protection
defensives.usage_rule: Use it during a heavy incoming damage window to reduce what you take while you keep fighting.

defensives.name: Lay on Hands
defensives.usage_rule: Use it as a full-health emergency heal on yourself or an ally about to die when nothing else will save them.

rules.description: Open Blade of Justice into your cooldowns
rules.action: Open with Blade of Justice, then Avenging Wrath with your on-use trinkets, then Execution Sentence, Wake of Ashes, and Divine Toll.

rules.description: Execution Sentence lines up with Avenging Wrath
rules.action: Wait for Avenging Wrath to be active before casting Execution Sentence so its full window gets the damage buff.

rules.description: Spend Art of War procs with Blade of Justice
rules.action: Cast Blade of Justice as soon as Art of War procs; you have two stacks of leeway but do not let a stack expire unused.

rules.description: Final Verdict spent at full Holy Power
rules.action: Hold Final Verdict for a full bar of Holy Power instead of spending it early.

rules.description: Divine Storm takes over on multiple targets
rules.action: Switch your Holy Power spender to Divine Storm once enough enemies are up instead of single-target finishers.
